name: 113-robust-eos-set-inside-tail
description: Robustness: the listener picks sleep at end of section while the playhead is in the closing silence of segment 0 (paused at 2.2 s of 2.71 s, past the 0.9 s stop point). Playback reaches the end of that section 0.5 s after play, so it must stop there (SleepFired, parked at the start of 1) instead of playing on to the end of 15.
